buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) Text Clause(s) 2 SCOPE OF WORK: 2.1 Name of the work & Place of work Execution Deployment of Contractual Assistants (CAs) for platform duty at Mangalore Central and Mangalore Jn. Railway Statio ns for a period of 02 years. Mangalore Central & Mangalore junction Railway Station, Dakshina Kannada District, Mangaluru, Karnataka. 2.2 Details of Work 1. The contractor should depute the staff for 03 shifts (06-14 hrs, 14-22 hrs & 22-06 hrs) round the clock, for the PF TR Activities in both MAQ & MAJN. 2. The deputed contract staff should turn off the Lights, fans and any other electrical items in the Non AC Coaches of arrival trains at MAQ & MAJN stations. 3. The deputed staff shall ensure that the lights, fans, and other electrical fittings in the Non-AC coaches of departi ng trains from MAQ & MAJN stations are switched on 45 minutes prior to the scheduled departure of the train. 4. The staff shall check and ensure that all lights in the Non AC Coaches and the Guard Coach of every train are fu nctioning properly. 5. The deputed Contract staff should attend and replace the mobile charging fuses, defective fans and lights in the coaches whenever a complaint is raised by the Railway Engineer /In charge Engineer or Electrical Control, MYS. 6. If any through-feed power supply extension is required from an adjacent coach, it shall be arranged by contractu al staff (Material should be collected from Railways). 7. Staff should co-ordinate with SMR, Points men and C&W staff to know the exact condition of arrival and departur

e of trains from the said stations. 8. Staff should wear proper uniform and keep the necessary tools like screwdriver, cutting plier, panel key etc., Con tractor should arrange the required tools for the deputed Contract staff. 9. Deputed staff should be spare the contact numbers/Mobile Number of the Concern supervisor for contacting the m for any emergency. 10. Perform any other duties assigned by respective Engineer in-charge as per “DUTY LIST OF AC/TL STAFF AT PLATFOR M” vide IRCAMTECH.M.GWL.Duty List C&W Staff May’2021 RDSO or latest version. 11. Before submitting the offer, Tenderers are requested to go through the following special conditions and Genera lco nditions as made applicable for this contract duly assessing the work by visiting MAQ & MAJN at Mangaluru. 12. Any doubts on the preview of scope of work are to be got clarified personally from Senior Divisional Electrical (G) En gineer, Mysuru so as to get better understanding on scope/essence of the contract. The motive in outsourcing of ser vices is to prefer quality services from the competent agency who can execute the work without any compromising on safety standards, rules and regulations and other provisions made for the smooth execution of contract. 2.3 Completion Period 1. Each Schedule of work shall be completed within 24 Months from its date of Commencement. The work shall be st arted in consultation with SSE/E/TL/MAQ as per terms and conditions of contract after acceptance of LOA. 2. In case if the entire work is not able to complete within the given period, the extension of time will be granted as p er clause 5 of Indian Railways General Conditions of Contract for Services - January 2018 or latest. The Contractor sh all apply for extension before 15 days of expiry of the period of completion. 2.4 Duties of Contract Assistants (CAs) 1. Contract Assistants deployed by the contractor shall work under the control of Railway SSE Electrical/ Train lighting (Engineer in-charge) of that station or his authorized representative and shall follow the instructions given by him. 2. To operate firefighting equipments (fire extinguishers) in case of fire accidents under the instructions of Railway in- charge. 3. To attend to any emergency arising out of accidents, flooding etc., under the instructions of Railway in-charge. 4. The contractor shall be responsible for safe custody of equipments and their staff till completion of work. To appear in the prescribed uniform approved by Railways and have his badge (Name plate) fixed on it to be easily i dentified by travelling public 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 3 SPECIAL CONDITIONS OF CONTRACT These special conditions should be read in conjunction with the General Instructions of this tender and Indian Railways General Conditions of Contract for Services - January 2018 or latest. In the event of an y conflict or inconsistency between the Indian Railways General Conditions of Contract for Services - Ja nuary 2018 and Special Conditions of Contract, the provisions of Special Conditions of Contract contain ed herein shall prevail. 3.1 Recovery Clause: All the works shall be carried out by strictly following the safety measure mention ed in special conditions of contract and elsewhere in the tender document. If any damages and disfigur ation caused to any Railway property by the Contractor due to the negligence of contractor’s staff in c arrying out the scheduled work, it shall immediately be brought to the notice of the concerned Railway official and it must be made good by the Contractor at his own cost failing which cost of such repairs/ damages or detentions shall be recovered from the Contractor. Further non-reporting of such incidents within 15 minutes of happening will attract penalty as decided by Sr. DEE/G/MYS. 3.2 Summary of Penalties: Contractor shall ensure that their staff report for duty at nominated station s without fail. If needed the contractor shall keep spare staff at his own cost to ensure 100% reporting

for duty. SN Nature of default / non-compliance Penalty / Action 1 Failure to deploy personnel as per the specified Rs.5,000/- per occasion. timings, except where the delay is attributable to the Railways, as certified by the Engineer-in- Charge 2 Personnel found without a valid competency ce Rs.500/- per person per instance, recoverable from the rtificate, identity card or prescribed uniform, in Contractor's bill. an untidy condition. 3 Personnel found smoking, consuming liquor or r Rs.2,000/- per person per incident. The concerned pers eporting for duty under the influence of alcohol onnel shall be permanently debarred from further depl . oyment under the contract. 4 Misbehavior by the Contractor's personnel, incl Rs.1,000/- per person per incident. The concerned pers uding the supervisor, towards Railway officials onnel shall be replaced by suitable personnel. 5 Misbehavior by the Contractor himself towards Rs.2,000/- per incident. In case of repeated misconduc Railway officials. t, the contract shall be liable for termination, with forfe iture of Performance Guarantee (PG) and any other du es payable to the Contractor, as applicable. The defaul ting Contractor shall also be debarred from participatin g in the re-tendering of the same work 6 Failure to deploy 1 Diploma holder for contract Rs.25,000/- each month or Part thereof for the default value “Above Rs.25 Lakhs & less than 2 crore” period. 7 Failure to deploy 1 Graduate Engineer (Or 2 Rs.40,000/- each month or Part thereof for the default Diploma holder) for contract value “Above Rs.2 period. 5 Lakhs & less than 2 crore” Note: In cases of repeated misconduct by the Contractor, the decision of Sr.DEE/G/MYS shall be final. 3.3 Inspection: The inspecting officer(s) for this contract shall be the Senior Divisional Electrical (G) En gineer/MYS or his authorized representative. The inspection shall be carried out at the sole discretion of Railways. 3.4 Price Variation: No price variation for this contract will be applicable. The price value quoted by the contractor and accepted by the Railway shall be treated as firm during the entire period of completion of work. 3.5 PRICE & PAYMENT 1. Prices shall be quoted as per details shown in Schedule of work. The prices quoted shall be firm and not subject t o variations for any reasons whatsoever. The prices quoted shall be NET including all taxes and duties etc. 2. Payment shall be released on monthly basis for the completed trips of all trains on submission of monthly bill a fter inspection & testing by an authorized representative of Railway as per schedule of work. 3. Documents required for passing of CC Bills: Engineer in-charge: The measurements shall be duly recorded in the Measurement Book (MB) and jointly signed b y the Engineer-in-Charge and the contractor's representative. The Engineer-in-Charge shall certify in the Measurem ent Book that: “The work has been carried out to the satisfaction of Railways. It is further certified that all reports, st atements, registers, certifications etc., as stipulated under the agreement conditions, have been jointly signed by th e undersigned (Engineer-in-Charge) and the contractor's representative for the relevant billing period, and all such r ecords are available in the safe custody of the Engineer-in-Charge's office.” Any penalties imposed during the billing period shall be duly recorded in the Measurement Book by the Engineer-in- Charge and duly specifying appropriate agreement clause. In case no penalty is applicable, the same shall be record ed and certified by Engineer in-charge in the Measurement Book with the following endorsement: “No penalty is app licable for the current billing period.”

The concerned Engineer-in-Charge shall be responsible for ensuring that all documentation, including reports, state ments, registers, certificates, etc., as stipulated under the agreement conditions, is duly completed and verified for t he period of work executed, for which measurements recorded, for processing the payment. Firm: (a) The contractor shall submit the bill in the prescribed Railway format, in triplicate, shall be duly pre-receipted, comp lete in all respects and accompanied by all relevant supporting documents. The complete bill along with the required documents shall be submitted to the concerned SSE/Engineer-in-Charge for verification and processing. (b) List of employees engaged by the contractor month-wise and their details such as name, passport size photo, Aadha ar, education certificate, amount contributed towards EPF & ESI/ group insurance, Police verification certificate, medi cal certificate duly signed by Engineer in-charge. (c) Attendance of employees duly signed by Engineer in-charge. (d) Payment to the contract labours should be paid through bank / cheque .Proof of salary paid to them duly ensuring th e latest minimum wages should be submitted duly signed by Engineer in-charge. (e) Self-certified copies of vouchers received from EPF & ESI organizations duly signed by Engineer in-charge 4. Procedure for claiming payment will be as per the provisions contained in Indian Railways General Conditions of C ontract for Services - January 2018 or latest. 5. Payment will be made as per the schedule of work, after inspection and testing by an authorized Railway’s repres entative for the actual quantity of work carried out. 6. All the claims for payment shall be produced in Railway’s Standard bill proforma duly certified by the concerned Engineer-in-charge, after recording the measurement book as per extant rule 7. The bill-passing officer is Sr.DEE/G/MYS and the bill-paying officer is Sr. DFM/MYS. Engineer in-charge is SSE/E/TL/ MAQ. 8. All rates quoted in the tenders shall be deemed to be inclusive of CGST, SGST payable by the contracto rto the G overnment or any public body and no additional amount/rate or claim will be entertained on this account by the Railw ays. Also no claim whatsoever will be accepted by Railways on account of revision of tax rates, new taxes of statutor y nature by State/Central Govt. 9. Railways shall not be liable for any other charges except the rate accepted as per Price schedule. Under no circum stances, the rates quoted by the contractor and accepted by the Railways shall be enhanced during the entire perio d of contract. 10. Payment through Letter of Credit (LC) (a) Contractor shall have the option to take payment from Rly. through a LC arrangement. (b) This option of taking payment through LC arrangements has to be exercised in IREPS (Indian Railway Electronic Proc urement System - the e-application on which tenders are called by Railways) by the tenderer at the time of bidding i tself, and the tenderer shall affirm having read over and agreed to the terms and conditions of the LC option. (c) The option so exercised, shall be an integral part of the bidder’s offer. The above option of taking payment through LC arrangement, once exercised by tenderer at the time of bidding, shal l be final and no change shall be permitted, thereafter, during execution of contract . 4.
